accounting.denominator_rule: Count every dispatched or possibly dispatched actor attempt, including completed, failed, timed out and interrupted attempts. Preserve all 54 assigned cells and show NOT_RUN/BLOCKED separately.
accounting.dispatch_boundary: Immediately before an actor invocation can reach the host/provider, S078 commits an attempt-start reservation to its single-writer ledger. Mark dispatch DISPATCHED once observed. A crash or lost receipt after this boundary is UNKNOWN and conservatively spends one attempt.
accounting.preparation_failure: A proven pre-dispatch failure is BLOCKED or NOT_RUN with dispatch_state=NOT_DISPATCHED, counted_actor_attempt=false and actor_quota_consumed=0. It remains an assigned cell, has a safe failure category, and cannot be replaced with another case or arm.
accounting.preparation_recovery: Local preflight repair before any possible dispatch is preparation, not a model retry. Preserve its events and duration. Never reclassify an ambiguous dispatch as preparation or automatically replay it.
accounting.interruption_mapping: Use launch-v1 status FAILED with failure_reason=interrupted for a dispatched interruption; use TIMEOUT when the frozen deadline is exceeded. Do not add an incompatible cell status.
accounting.no_answer: A spent attempt without a public final answer remains in attempted totals. Missing score or usage stays null with an explicit reason; absence is not success.
accounting.reservation_recovery: After a crash, reconcile the durable ledger before dispatching anything. A possibly dispatched reservation is terminal FAILED or TIMEOUT, counted and never replayed. State transitions retain safe prior status events.
accounting.single_writer: Only S078 dispatches actor invocations. Persist reservations and terminal updates atomically in its own ledger and resource lease. S043 assignments do not themselves dispatch or allocate a second quota.

study_totals.attempted_count: sum(counted_actor_attempt=true); <=54, including STARTED and every terminal dispatched/unknown outcome
study_totals.completed_count: terminal COMPLETED count; not a quality-pass claim
study_totals.failed_count: terminal FAILED count including interrupted attempts
study_totals.attempted_pass_rate: passes / all attempted cells, including failures, timeouts, interruptions and pending/unscored attempts; disclose those counts and lower/upper pass bounds rather than remove them
study_totals.assigned_pass_fraction: passes / 54, separately labeled if reported; do not silently substitute this for the launch-v1 attempted denominator
study_totals.forbidden_denominator: completed or successful answers only, excluding failures, timeouts, interruptions, missing usage or inconvenient outcomes
study_totals.missing_score_bounds: For attempted_count >0, lower=known_passes/attempted_count and upper=(known_passes+eligible_unresolved_scores)/attempted_count. Failed/time-out attempts without a passing final answer are known non-passes, not eligible unresolved scores. With no attempts, rates are null.

accounting.backend_request_boundary: 54 limits actor invocations/responses, not an assertion that an opaque host made exactly 54 provider requests. Meter all exposed subrequests and full interaction usage. Any tool/model continuation policy and numeric subrequest caps must be frozen before calls. Unobservable backend requests remain null/unavailable; no claimed verification of a hidden cap.
accounting.stop_rule: Pause new dispatch for quota exhaustion, input/isolation/identity drift, lost lease, unsafe retention, host failure or deadline. Emerging favorable/unfavorable quality is not an early-stop rule. Retain all attempted cells and unattempted assignments.

freeze.reason: Authoring complete does not freeze the experiment. Dependencies and S078 decisions must be reconciled before the first actor call.
required_input_hashes: all synthetic case and arm instruction files
S078 decision register and execution/collection limits
freeze.post_outcome_change: Do not modify caps, thresholds, input text, scoring or exclusion rules after outcomes. A safety stop preserves every reservation and outcome. Repairs require a separately authorized frozen follow-up, never selective replay.
freeze.program_deadline_source: control/run.json as observed at authoring; S001 owns any coordinated deadline state
freeze.deadline_behavior: Stop accepting new work/calls at the common deadline; preserve safe partial results and report PARTIAL/BLOCKED when required evidence is missing. S078 must choose an earlier dispatch stop to bound in-flight timeout and cleanup.

shared_ledger.schema_kind: field definitions and null template; not observed records
shared_ledger.identity_missing_rule: Each unknown identity value is null plus identity_unknown_reasons[field]. Requested/configured identity is not an observed backend identity.

study_id.meaning: Frozen round identifier; no quota partition by chat.

budget_sha256.meaning: Hash of this budget in the S001-selected pre-outcome freeze.

protocol_sha256.meaning: Hash of S031 protocol in that freeze.

freeze_manifest_sha256.meaning: Exact external freeze-manifest bytes; not a self-referential manifest hash.

cell_id.meaning: Unique immutable assigned cell; one actor attempt maximum.

repeat.meaning: One of 1,2,3; planned repeat, not retry.

assignment_seed.meaning: Ordering seed only, not backend determinism.

attempt_id.meaning: Locally generated synthetic actor id; never a private provider/session identifier.

attempt_index.meaning: 1 when reserved for dispatch; never 2 or higher.

call_role.meaning: actor; judge/recovery/diagnostic use separate approved ledgers and caps.

counted_actor_attempt.meaning: True for dispatch or possible dispatch; includes missing answers and failures.

actor_quota_consumed.meaning: 0 for proven no dispatch; 1 for dispatch or possible dispatch.

started_at.meaning: Observed start of the actor invocation immediately before possible dispatch.

ended_at.meaning: Observed public terminal answer/failure, timeout or interruption boundary.
ended_at.missing: Not observed or still in flight.

elapsed_ms.meaning: Monotonic whole actor interaction duration; includes tool/runtime overhead.
elapsed_ms.missing: Duration not observed; never substitute the configured timeout.

input_tokens.meaning: Observed input tokens for declared usage_scope; cached inclusion semantics separately declared.
input_tokens.missing: Provider/host did not provide comparable input usage.

cached_input_tokens.meaning: Observed cache-read/input-hit count; never assume it is additive to input_tokens.

cache_creation_input_tokens.meaning: Observed cache-write/creation count where separately reported.
cache_creation_input_tokens.missing: Cache creation usage unavailable; not zero.

output_tokens.meaning: Observed provider/host output usage, not inferred from visible string length.

total_tokens.meaning: Observed provider/host total under explicit accounting semantics.
total_tokens.missing: Total unavailable; do not invent input+output as provider total.

usage_source.meaning: Documented host/provider meter field; never store raw events.

provider_subrequest_count.meaning: Actually exposed requests within this actor interaction.
provider_subrequest_count.missing: Opaque host/backend; not assumed to be 1.

cost_amount.meaning: Actually reported attributable cost only, with currency and scope.

identity.meaning: All source_identity keys; unknown values null with explicit reasons.

identity_unknown_reasons.meaning: Safe per-field reason for missing observed identities.

measurement_unknown_reasons.meaning: Safe per-field reasons for null time, usage, cost, burden and backend counts.

public_final_answer.meaning: Only the public final answer to a newly authored public synthetic case. No raw host transcript.

public_final_answer_sha256.meaning: Digest of exact retained public final answer bytes.

entry_emitted.meaning: Actual supported entry observation only; installation does not imply it.

canonical_full_read.meaning: Supported complete-read observation; never inferred from discovery or footer.

application_evidence.meaning: unverified unless actual supported public evidence; do not fabricate native receipts.

task_complete.meaning: Public rubric outcome, separate from host COMPLETED status.

critical_error_labels.meaning: Predeclared public rubric labels only; empty does not imply an unscored result passed.

edit_burden.meaning: Separate observer metrics on synthetic public artifacts; never replace the scored original answer.

shared_ledger.v1_adapter: Preserve all launch-v1 result fields. Extra accounting fields may be a sidecar keyed by cell_id if S044 uses a closed result schema; do not weaken its sanitizer or force it to accept fields.

time_definitions.timestamp_clock: UTC wall-clock timestamps locate events; do not subtract wall clocks when an observed monotonic timer exists.
time_definitions.elapsed_ms: 1000 x (monotonic terminal boundary - monotonic actor invocation start). Includes all observed host/tool/provider overhead for that single-turn interaction; excludes pre-dispatch queue and preparation.
time_definitions.queue_wait_ms: Dispatch start minus queued time, separately observed; null if unavailable.
time_definitions.preparation_elapsed_ms: Observed local setup/preflight duration before any possible actor dispatch; separate from actor elapsed.
time_definitions.cleanup_elapsed_ms: Observed time after terminal collection to bounded cleanup, separately measured; do not fold it silently into latency.
time_definitions.study_wall_elapsed_ms: Observed monotonic interval from first actor attempt start to last terminal boundary; includes overlap once, not sum of concurrent cell durations.
time_definitions.sum_actor_elapsed_ms: Sum of observed cell elapsed values with observed/missing counts; not study wall time.
time_definitions.timeout_rule: Record actual observed duration and timeout category. If the timer result is unavailable, elapsed_ms is null even when a timeout limit is known.
time_definitions.cancellation_rule: Count any dispatched/uncertain interrupted attempt and its observed duration; do not replace it.
time_definitions.aggregation: Report per-arm/family/locale counts and observed duration sum/min/median/max with sample counts; use nearest-rank p95 only with its n disclosed. Never treat missing duration as zero or claim a speed advantage from Fast configuration.
time_definitions.hook_latency_boundary: Do not combine synthetic hook-process p95 from measure_codex_hook_timing.py with actor latency or interpret it as answer quality.

token_definitions.measurement_scope: Entire single-turn actor interaction, including exposed tool-followup/provider subrequests and required output. If only part is exposed, label partial_interaction with missing scope rather than claim a total.
token_definitions.input: Observed meter input tokens; whether cache-read/write counts are included must be explicit.
token_definitions.cache: Keep cache-read and cache-creation counts separate; never add a cached-input subset twice.
token_definitions.output: Observed meter output usage; public character/word counts are separate text-size metrics, not tokens.
token_definitions.total: Retain actually reported total_tokens. A derived input-plus-output quantity, if useful, has its own derived label and requires known compatible scopes and cache semantics; it never replaces a missing observed total.
token_definitions.missing_usage: null plus explicit reason and coverage count, including for failed or timed-out attempts. No tokenizer guesses, zero filling, provider reconstruction or outcome-dependent exclusions.
token_definitions.aggregation: For every metric publish known_sum, observed_cell_count, missing_cell_count and partial_scope_count across all attempted cells, including failures/timeouts. all_cells_total is null unless every attempted cell has comparable complete usage. Keep role and provider-accounting strata separate.
token_definitions.cross_model_comparison: Do not equate token counts across unverified tokenizers/backends; unknown backend identity remains unknown.
token_definitions.billing: No price, availability, exact backend or monetary amount is inferred from requested model, effort, configuration or an historical protocol.

edit_burden_definitions.scope: Optional observed post-answer editing of public synthetic output only. The original scored answer is immutable and receives no favorable replacement.
edit_burden_definitions.observer_state: unavailable until S078 predeclares an authorized observer; missing observation is not zero burden
edit_burden_definitions.null_reason: No experiment or edit observation performed by S039.
edit_burden_definitions.active_edit_ms_definition: Sum observed intervals during active editing; exclude waiting/model execution, avoid double-counting overlapping intervals and disclose observer/timing method.
edit_burden_definitions.revision_count_definition: Number of observed saved post-answer public revisions; do not infer keystrokes or subjective effort.
edit_burden_definitions.distance_definition: If enabled before outcomes: Levenshtein insert/delete/substitute distance over Unicode scalars of exact public original/final text, with unit costs and no normalization. Missing original/final or measurement gives null.
edit_burden_definitions.burden_ratio_definition: Optional distance/original_unicode_scalars only when denominator >0 and both metrics observed; otherwise null. It measures text change, not correctness or human difficulty.
edit_burden_definitions.comparison_limits: Report by locale; whitespace word-like or Korean eojeol-like counts and Unicode size are descriptive only. Do not truncate required output to improve burden or length metrics.
edit_burden_definitions.authoring_cost: Time/tokens spent creating the 100 chats, protocol, fixtures or this file stay outside actor metrics. If observed for operations, label separate authoring/preparation totals.
edit_burden_definitions.no_new_model_calls: Burden measurement authorizes no model revision, judge, translation or repair calls.

evidence_and_identity.native_vs_manual: native-opensocrates requires actual approved installed-native isolation/delivery conditions. Manual canonical content injection is a separate transformed condition and cannot be relabeled native or substituted for an unavailable native arm.
evidence_and_identity.native_unavailable: Record BLOCKED/NOT_RUN for a proven pre-dispatch native blocker; otherwise retain dispatched failure/timeout. Do not create an unplanned fourth arm or borrow its quota.
evidence_and_identity.installation_delivery_application_useful: Record installation state, emitted entry, complete read, application evidence and public task outcome separately. None proves the next; no native application receipt is fabricated.
evidence_and_identity.independent_judge_state: unknown/unavailable until an actually authorized independent reviewer is observed; self-review and another drafting chat are not independent human judgment.
evidence_and_identity.backend_model_unknown_reason: No experiment run; requested host/model name does not prove backend identity.
evidence_and_identity.service_tier_unknown_reason: Fast/priority configuration is a requested setting, not observed server routing or a verified experimental speed condition.
evidence_and_identity.availability_or_price: unknown; no current availability, backend identity or pricing attestation is made

allowed: newly authored public synthetic case inputs and arm instructions
public final answers to those synthetic cases under the frozen limited retention window
synthetic cell ids, statuses, safe error categories and actual command exit codes
observed aggregate timing/token/cost/edit metrics and public rubric labels
forbidden: raw private user prompts or conversations
raw host logs or event streams
credentials, tokens, account ids, provider/session identifiers or authentication configuration
copied active authentication or user home data
hidden reasoning or chain of thought
retention_contract.collection_boundary: Collect allowed fields directly or sanitize in memory; do not retain raw logs first and promise later deletion. Store safe error categories rather than raw exception text.
retention_contract.public_answer_boundary: An unsafe or private final answer is withheld with answer_unavailable and safe reason; keep the attempt and observed safe usage in totals. Do not retain disallowed content merely because the host displayed it.
retention_contract.retention_pending_reason: S078/S001 must fix a finite answer-retention window and deletion owner before outcome collection; fixture preregistration is not consent to capture user work.
retention_contract.host_policy: This study contract does not assert or alter the host/provider conversation-retention policy.
